angles.title: Position candid work without promising no guidance

quotes.speaker: Shannon Lee
quotes.text: Shannon Lee: Um, the only thing I'd say is I, I do pose people, I just don't pose them awkwardly or stiff, so I don't know if I want one that says specifically no posing at all. I do take, like, 90% candids, and that is the branding that I base off of.

quotes.speaker: Shannon Lee
quotes.text: Shannon Lee: I just don't want someone to think that I'm never going to help them out when they're struggling.

quotes.speaker: Shannon Lee
quotes.text: Shannon Lee: most of my clients are like, yes, we want, like, all those real moments, we don't want you to pose us until we get to our couple's portraits, then can you please… can you please tell us what to do with our hands? And that's why I don't want them to think that I won't pose them at all, because a lot of them come to me, like, on consult calls.

quotes.speaker: Shannon Lee
quotes.text: Shannon Lee: Oh, what about authentic, not staged?

angles.title: Give distinct wedding markets distinct landing-page context

quotes.speaker: Carmen Cruickshank
quotes.text: Carmen Cruickshank: Awesome. And you just wanted to do Orlando area, nothing with Denver right now, correct?

quotes.speaker: Shannon Lee
quotes.text: Shannon Lee: I think that's the plan, because I feel like it's hard to target both markets with one landing page, because a lot of my Colorado weddings want to see mountains, and a lot of my Florida weddings don't.

quotes.speaker: Shannon Lee
quotes.text: Shannon Lee: So I think at some point I might, you know.

quotes.speaker: Shannon Lee
quotes.text: Shannon Lee: try and target Colorado, but for now, we're just gonna go with Orlando.

angles.title: Check buyer meaning before excluding a style keyword
angles.filename: Carmen Cruickshank's Personal Meeting Room's transcript (3).txt

quotes.speaker: Shannon Lee
quotes.text: Shannon Lee: light and airy is, like, a term that people use and, like, search for when it comes to photography, and that is not what I am, and I sometimes get inquiries who will put that in the contact form.

quotes.speaker: Shannon Lee
quotes.text: Shannon Lee: saying that's what they want. But I also think that I don't trust couples to actually know what they want or know how to properly describe what they're looking for. So I don't know if I would negative that out. Um, but that's the only other thing that I could kind of think of when it's clearly a misalign, a misalignment of a client.

quotes.speaker: Carmen Cruickshank
quotes.text: Carmen Cruickshank: Mm-hmm. Normally, do those people that mention light in the area, do they end up becoming clients, or no?

quotes.speaker: Shannon Lee
quotes.text: Shannon Lee: I mean, I've had a couple in the last year mention it and I think one out of like four or five became my client.

quotes.speaker: Carmen Cruickshank
quotes.text: Carmen Cruickshank: Okay, that's good. Yeah, we could definitely leave it there. And if we see a lot of people are searching it and it's just becoming irrelevant for some reason, then we can take it out. But that's good to know.

angles.title: Make an all-inclusive venue comparison about scope, not just fees

quotes.speaker: Lauren Christensen
quotes.text: Lauren Christensen: because there's not a lot of all-inclusives where we are, we are always getting compared to, like, you know, because they're… all the other venues in our area that they're touring when they come tour us are venue rental only, so they're bringing all the stuff in, right? So, they might see a venue rental cost of $10,000, and then they're looking at our cost, which is $30, and they clearly know there's more in there, but they don't really know the value of those things.

quotes.speaker: Lauren Christensen
quotes.text: Lauren Christensen: Yeah, we have it in our current website, like a venue comparison chart. I do think, like, visually it could look better than it does, it's just kind of basic looking, um, but I have… I do think that that's helpful, and I try to kind of emphasize that with people in follow-up. When I'm doing my follow-ups after tours, or even if they've got a lot of questions ahead of time, yeah, like, look at everything we have, and then look at, like, what you're gonna.

quotes.speaker: Lauren Christensen
quotes.text: Lauren Christensen: do on your own and, like, here's an estimated cost for what that will cost you to do that outside of this.

quotes.speaker: Whitney Hodges
quotes.text: Whitney Hodges: So I do think on the landing page that that would be pretty powerful to include.

angles.title: Match wedding-venue ad creative to the buyer's next question

quotes.speaker: Lauren Christensen
quotes.text: Lauren Christensen: Do each of those have separate creative, too, in terms of, like, what we're putting out there for people, or is it all one… one creative, and then you're just targeting different ways?

quotes.speaker: Whitney Hodges
quotes.text: Whitney Hodges: No, it's really different objectives for each layer of the funnel, because, um, you know, there are different things that we want to accomplish with those, and people are going to be kind of at different stages as well, right? So, for completely, like, cold audiences, client attraction is what we call it.

quotes.speaker: Whitney Hodges
quotes.text: Whitney Hodges: Coming across you in the newsfeed or in their stories, right? Um, it's kind of an introduction to the brand, um, versus the conversion campaigns where the goal really is to get them to inquire, to get them to book a tour. That is going to feel more like an ad, right? Because it's direct response. We're asking something.

quotes.speaker: Whitney Hodges
quotes.text: Whitney Hodges: of them. Um, and then bottom of funnel is typically retargeting ads, so warm audience members, people who maybe have already inquired or even scheduled, um, a tour. Um, for those, again, we like for it to feel a bit more organic.

quotes.speaker: Whitney Hodges
quotes.text: Whitney Hodges: But the purpose is very different than just introducing the penny to them. It's more like the why of why they should book with you, overcoming some of those objectives, like talking about why it would be better to go with you than a competitor, how all-inclusive is going to be so much more stress-free than the alternative sort of thing. So it's more meant to be.

quotes.speaker: Whitney Hodges
quotes.text: Whitney Hodges: Content that you would want to share that goes deeper than just.

quotes.speaker: Whitney Hodges
quotes.text: Whitney Hodges: Hey, look at our beautiful venue that you've never heard of before, if that makes sense.
